snippet.title: Supermarket Cola Dash Classic
snippet.description:
This is an endless runner style game I made a couple of months ago
There's no music/sounds since I do not know how to make that so just pop something in the background if u wanna play it (Try to get 100+ points if you can!)
https://camer-the-dragon.itch.io/supermarket-cola-dash
